prompt:
A desktop app screen, landscape 16:10, rendered edge to edge as the screen itself (no browser window, no device frame). The app is "Tagalong", a crew of AI pets that work together in a small office. Screen: "Crew Office".

Layout, region by region:
1. Top bar, full width: deep navy (#0E1230) with "Tagalong HQ" at left, a standard search-style input "@Bolt review this PR" in the centre, and a gold (#F2C14E) "Assign" button.
2. Left column, about 22% width: a "Party" window in the style of a 16-bit RPG menu, royal blue (#1C2A7A) fill with a thin white rounded border; four rows each with a small 16-bit pixel sprite, the name, and the job class in small caps: "Scout — GENERALIST — At desk", "Ink — WRITER — Room 2", "Bolt — BACKEND ENGINEER — Working", "Sage — RESEARCHER — Needs you" (Sage highlighted with a gold cursor arrow and a gold "!" badge).
3. Centre, about 48% width: a detailed top-down 16-bit pixel-art office map: wooden floor tiles, four desks with small pets typing, two walled meeting rooms labelled "Room 1" and "Room 2"; three pets sit around Room 2's table with a small speech bubble.
4. Right column, about 30%: a blue bordered window titled "Meeting · Launch blog post · Room 2" with a chat log: "Sage: Ink, can you tighten the intro?", "Ink: Done. It now leads with what users get.", "Sage: Pixel, can you make a hero image?"; under it a horizontal gauge "Calls 4 / 12" styled like an HP bar, and a text input "Join and type…".

Style: polished modern desktop app wearing 16-bit RPG menu windows; readable crisp sans for body text, pixel font only for names and window titles; clean grid and generous spacing.
